jobs.title: Data & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Profile

Webbtree makes software to help companies find and hire great people. We get recruiting and its role in building healthy workplaces. And while we take recruiting seriously, we don't take ourselves too seriously.

At Webbtree, you'll find smart people who have fun, learn and innovate, and help others do the same.

We brainstorm, we laugh, and, occasionally, we party (there's a lot to celebrate), but we also appreciate people's need for quiet time and focused work.

We respect everyone, we hire the best, and make sure every experience is special.

If that’s not enough to join, we’re backed by a multi-national Executive Search firm - WhiteCrow Research that has been working with Global Fortune 100 companies for more than 12 years.

DATA & AI ENGINEER

Mumbai, India | Hybrid | Full-time | 2+ years

About The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Data & AI Engineer to work on the data, search, analytics and AI systems powering our recruitment platform. This is not a traditional data analyst/reporting role. You will work across large-scale search, data engineering, analytics, NLP and Generative AI, including OpenSearch, vector search, embeddings, reranking, LLMs and AI-driven retrieval/screening systems.

What You'll Work On

Design, build and optimise large-scale search/retrieval pipelines using OpenSearch / Elasticsearch.
Work with keyword, vector, semantic and hybrid search; embeddings, ranking, relevance and filtering.
Design scalable MySQL data models, schemas, indexes and queries; optimise database performance.
Build ingestion, transformation, indexing/re-indexing and data pipelines supporting AI, analytics and reporting.
Build BI-ready datasets and Tableau dashboards; ensure data quality and consistency.
Experiment with and evaluate embeddings, rerankers, LLMs and ML models using accuracy, relevance, latency and cost.
Build LLM/GenAI workflows using LangChain and Langfuse; support tracing, observability and evaluation.
Take AI/data experiments from POC → production with backend and product teams; optimise latency, throughput, reliability and cost.
Work with AWS infrastructure including OpenSearch, S3, EC2 and RDS.

MUST HAVE

2+ years of hands-on experience in OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, ML/AI/GenAI, Search/Information Retrieval or Data Engineering.
Strong Python programming and extremely strong SQL skills.
Production experience with MySQL: schema design, query optimisation, indexing and performance tuning.
Strong data modelling/database design and experience with large-scale data pipelines/datasets.
Practical ML/AI model evaluation experience and understanding of experimentation metrics.
Experience with at least one of: LLMs, NLP, Generative AI, embedding models, reranking models or recommendation/search systems.
Experience integrating external ML/AI models through APIs.

GOOD TO HAVE

Tableau/BI, data warehouses or analytics layers; Langfuse or similar observability/evaluation platforms.
RAG/retrieval pipelines, vector databases, rerankers/cross-encoders, Hugging Face/open-source models.
AWS (OpenSearch, S3, EC2, RDS), high-volume search, NLP/information retrieval/recommendation systems.
Familiarity with MRR, NDCG, Recall@K and Precision@K; Docker and CI/CD.

What We're Looking For

Someone extremely hands-on with data who thinks in SQL first, is deeply comfortable with MySQL and data modelling, and can move seamlessly between data engineering, analytics and AI experimentation. You should be comfortable going from data → experiment → evaluation → optimisation → production, while also building reporting layers for business users.

WHY THIS ROLE IS INTERESTING

Own the full data lifecycle: how data is stored, queried, used for analytics, powers search and powers AI. This is a rare opportunity where data engineering, analytics and AI engineering converge in one system, with direct influence over how data is structured, search works and AI systems behave in production.

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also considered.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer - JAVA AI
jobs.description:
Position Description

Java AI Apprentice

Role Summary

The Java AI Apprentice will work with senior engineers and architects to design, develop, and support AI powered applications and intelligent automation solutions. The role focuses on building scalable Java based applications, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), developing AI agents, and implementing modern cloud native and microservices architectures. This apprenticeship provides hands on exposure to Generative AI, enterprise application development, and emerging AI engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain Java based applications, microservices, and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and related frameworks.
Assist in integrating Generative AI services, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI powered capabilities into enterprise applications.
Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services to support AI applications, chatbots, virtual assistants, and intelligent workflows.
Collaborate with senior developers to design and implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
Develop AI agent workflows and automation solutions using modern AI frameworks and orchestration tools.
Implement prompt engineering techniques and optimize AI model interactions for accuracy, performance, and user experience.
Support deployment and monitoring of AI applications on cloud platforms using containerized environments and CI/CD pipelines.
Contribute to application testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization activities.
Create technical documentation, developer guides, and knowledge sharing materials for AI and Java based solutions.
Participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and continuous learning activities related to software engineering and AI technologies.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

jobs.description:
Position Description

Job Description (JD) – Python AI ApprenticePosition Title

Python AI Apprentice

About The Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and self motivated Python AI Apprentice to join our AI and Automation team. The apprentice will work on developing AI powered applications, automation solutions, machine learning models, and data driven insights using Python and modern AI technologies.

This role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about programming, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and emerging technologies, and are eager to gain hands on industry experience.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain Python based applications and automation scripts.

Assist in building AI and Machine Learning solutions using modern frameworks.

Work with structured and unstructured datasets for data analysis and model training.

Support the development of Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) applications.

Create APIs and integrations for AI enabled solutions.

Participate in testing, debugging, and optimizing Python applications.

Collaborate with senior developers, data scientists, and business stakeholders.

Document code, processes, and technical solutions.

Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, Machine Learning, and Python technologies.Required SkillsTechnical Skills

Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python programming.

Understanding of Object Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.

Familiarity with data structures and algorithms.

Basic knowledge of SQL and databases.

Exposure to Machine Learning fundamentals.

Understanding of REST APIs and web services.

Knowledge of Git/version control systems.

AI/ML Knowledge

Basic understanding of:

Machine Learning concepts

Data preprocessing

Model training and evaluation

Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)

Prompt Engineering

Preferred Skills

Experience with any of the following:

Pandas

NumPy

Scikit learn

TensorFlow or PyTorch

LangChain

OpenAI/Azure OpenAI Services

Streamlit or Flask

Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

Exposure to Power BI or data visualization tools.

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor's degree (or pursuing final year) in:

Computer Science

Information Technology

Artificial Intelligence

Data Science

Electronics & Communication

Related engineering disciplines

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem solving abilities.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Eagerness to learn new technologies.

Ability to work independently and within a team.

Attention to detail and commitment to quality.Learning Opportunities

During the apprenticeship, the candidate will gain hands on experience in:

Python Application Development

Machine Learning & Deep Learning

Generative AI & LLM Solutions

AI Agents and Automation

Cloud Based AI Services

API Development & Integration

Real world Enterprise AI Projects

Success Criteria

By the end of the apprenticeship, the candidate should be able to:

Build production ready Python applications.

Develop and deploy AI powered solutions.

Create data pipelines and automation workflows.

Integrate AI services with enterprise applications.

Contribute effectively to software development and AI projects.

Experience Required: Freshers / 0 1 Year

Duration: 6 12 Months (Apprenticeship Program)
